notes: Preservation districts sheet 1PD (Aug. 1993). One heavy frame rule (~9 px) on left, top and right; the bottom edge sits just above the thick bar (~24 px) that rules off the full-width legend and title strip (rule 3; the north arrow, scale bar and sheet number are in the strip, outside, so no remove polygon). No arcs, no other notches, no SECTION badge. The district letters A-K, SAN FRANCISCO BAY, the pier lettering and the pier-head line are map. The only ink under the outline: the pier-head line meeting the legend bar at x ~2862 (map ink truly touching the rule) and a 1-px nub on the right rule at y ~690. Each side's inner edge was measured every 5 px along the side (the dark run of the rule in a 3-px band, runs wider than the rule's median width replaced by outer edge + median width), smoothed with a +-60 px running median, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1), points every ~200 px; corners where straight fits of the last 300 px of the two sides meet. Every vertex checked on full-resolution close-ups.
